topic: What is sleep drive? Coffee, naps and adenosine (carousel)
caption:
How coffee and naps change the pressure to sleep that builds through the day.

Adenosine is one of several signals that build in the brain the longer you are awake. Caffeine blocks the receptors it acts on, so the pressure keeps building, but you feel less of it. A nap spends some of the same supply a night of sleep draws on.

New blog from Natalia Cajide. Full article: link in bio.
